title: Chapter 65 — Penetration: One Project to All Projects
intro: The penetration ladder and the share-growth playbook.

sections.title: Grow Within the Account
sections.content:
Winning one project from a builder does not mean you have won all their projects. Penetration is the deliberate process of growing your share of their total appliance spend.

Ask what other projects are coming. Offer to quote. Prove consistency. Earn more of their business over time — not all at once.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating penetration, ask:

Does the salesperson know what percentage of each account's total business they have?
Are they actively pursuing additional projects — or waiting to be asked?
